title.value: SkillQG: Learning to Generate Question for Reading Comprehension Assessment
title.justification: The paper focuses on a framework called SkillQG, designed for generating questions in reading comprehension assessment.
title.quote: We present SkillQG: a question generation framework with controllable comprehension types for assessing and improving machine reading comprehension models.

extractions.description: SkillQG is a question generation framework that enhances machine reading comprehension by generating questions based on five skill dimensions inspired by Bloom’s Taxonomy. The system improves question quality and controllability by incorporating skill-specific knowledge into the question generation process. Experimental results show that SkillQG enhances the performance of question answering systems by providing more relevant and skill-oriented questions, demonstrating improvements over baseline models.

secondary_categories.quote: We argue that generating questions with deeper comprehension brings two major benefits: (i) compared with factoid-based QG models, it reflects higher cognitive skills and requires an in-depth understanding of the input text.
